rationale: Lich refight HP outlier: gf11's table gives 500 HP and 'not weak vs fire', but gf2's bestiary (Lich (2): HP 800) and gf10-57-2 (800 HP, weak to Fire) agree on 800 HP, and gf1-122-5 says the second form is still hurt by Fire and Harm.
Kary refight HP outlier: gf11 gives 700 HP; gf2's bestiary entry 'Kary (2)' gives HP 800.
Kraken refight HP outlier: gf11 gives 900 HP; gf2's bestiary 'Kraken (2)' and gf10-56-2/gf10-33-1 (corroborated by gf7, gf8) give 1000 HP.
Kraken refight HP: gf1 lists 800 HP (the Sea Shrine figure) for the Temple of Fiends refight; gf2 ('Kraken (2)' HP 1,000) and gf10 (1000 HP) agree on 1000.
Eye HP outlier: 182 HP; gf7 bestiary ('Eye 162'), gf10's own boss box ('BOSS BATTLE: Eye HP: 162') and gf11 (162) agree on 162. Its 'weak to Fire, Harm' line is also unsupported elsewhere.
Eye HP outlier: this gf10 table says 182 HP while gf10's walkthrough boss box, gf7 and gf11 say 162.
gf2 marks Kary's weakness as 'Ice?' (uncertain); ra-guide ('Resistant to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Poison') and gf11 (rF,rI,rL) both say Kary resists Ice.

Claims the Temple of Fiends Tiamat refight dies to one hit of Bane/Brak; gf1-122-11 says the refight is no longer weak to Bane, and gf11's TIAMAT* entry drops the w(BANE,BRAK) of the Floating Castle Tiamat.
